headline: Approved Dawn Savo as Director of Finance, with a budget amendment and employment agreement, 15-0.
summary: Savo described her professional experience and answered council questions about the town's financial challenges. A motion proposed changing Section 5 of her employment agreement by replacing “Community Initiatives” with two audit-related items.
decisions: Approved the order appointing Dawn Savo as Director of Finance, including a budget amendment and employment agreement, 15-0.

decision_titles: Approval of Dawn Savo as Director of Finance
plain_text:
TOWN OF HAMDEN, 
CONNECTICUT 
 
LEGISLATIVE COUNCIL 
SPECIAL MEETING  
 
7:00 PM, NOVEMBER 2, 2026 
MINUTES DRAFT 
 
Present - Katie Kiely, President 
Present - Sean Cardwell, Pro Tem 
Present - Sarah Gallagher, Maj Leader 
Present - Bob Anthony, Min Leader 
Present - Tasha Hunt, Majority Whip 
Present - Tom Figlar, Minority Whip 
Present - Maurine Crouch 
Present - Doug Foley 
Present - Jeron Alston 
Present - Abdul Osmanu 
Present - Rhonda Caldwell 
Present - Grace Teodosio 
Present - Adrian Webber 
 Present - Ted Stevens 
Present - Tameeka Parks 
 
1. Call to Order/Taking of the Roll  
Legislative Council Special Meeting, November 2, 2026.  The meeting was called 
to order at 7:15pm and the members noted above were in attendance.   
 
2. Public Comment Session 
Public comment session was opened at 7:18pm.  No members of the public 
came forward to give input and Public Comment was closed at 7:20pm. 
 
3. Special Meeting Agenda  
 
(a) Vote of the Legislative Council to Approve the “Order Providing for the 
Approval of Dawn Savo as the Director of Finance, including Budget 
Amendment and Employment Agreement”, as approved by the Committee 
of the Whole on October 28, 20261 
 
Motion to Open the Item: Majority Leader Gallagher 
Second: Finance Chair Alston 
 
Council member Alston moved to amend Section 5 of the Employment 
Agreement by striking “Community Initiatives” and adding two items, “Audit 
Budget Development” and “Town Audit Delivery,” as subsections E and F. 
The motion was seconded by Majority Leader Gallagher, and discussion 
was opened. 
 
Following an overview of her professional experience, Ms. Savo responded 
to questions regarding her approach to addressing the Town's financial 
challenges.
President Kiely called for the vote.  Minority Leader Anthony requested a 
roll call vote: 
 
Cardwell – Yes 
Gallagher – Yes 
Anthony – Yes 
Hunt – Yes 
Figlar – Yes 
Crouch – Yes 
Foley – Yes 
Alston – Yes 
Caldwell – Yes 
Teodosio- Yes 
Webber – Yes 
Stevens – Yes 
Parks – Yes 
Kiely – Yes 
Osmanu – Yes 
 
Vote: All in favor, the item passed unanimously. 
 
4. Executive Session, if necessary 
Not needed 
 
5. Adjournment  
With no additional business before the Council, President Kiely requested a 
motion to adjourn. 
 
The motion to adjourn was made by Minority Leader Anthony and seconded by 
Council member Parks.  The meeting was adjourned at 8:26pm.
